explication: gpt-oss is a collection of open-weight model inference implementations, agent tools, and evaluation programs. The main runtime workflow accepts a Harmony conversation through the chat client or Responses API, generates with a selected inference backend, and returns assistant output; when the model emits tool calls, the runtime dispatches them and continues generation. The graph also preserves the reference Torch, Triton, and Metal implementations and the evaluation branch. Some subsystem links rely on documented capabilities and the tree; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
